newsitem.title: USA: Nobel knows of no reason for share drop.
newsitem.headline: Nobel knows of no reason for share drop.

text.p: Nobel Education Dynamics Inc said Thursday it knows of no reason for its recent stock price decline.
In late morning trading, the stock was up 3/8 at 8-3/8, near its year low of 7-7/8, following a 5/8 fall on Wednesday. The year high is 18-1/4.

The company said it is pleased with the positive effect of recently closed acquisitions in Florida, North Carolina, Seattle and Southern California and said the acquisition of the Rainbow Bridge Schools in San Jose, Calif., is pending.
